about: Hunter step 6a's butterflies and moths, where live has them: each tile, level and type is the creature's OSRS Wiki page (its location table), every area included, quest areas too (Neypotzli, the Tonali Cavern, the Ruins of Tapoyauik count as open). Moonlight moths are all the catchable type (12771), guessed. Wander ranges are guessed (4). Left out: the Crypt of Tonali spawns the Wiki marks inaccessible, Puro-Puro.
